name: Logan Calder
life: “I once swapped shifts with a stranger for an entire month before meeting him.” On Monday, near Tideline Market, Logan picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I changed the roster to save wages. Now I eat alone next to five imaginary people.
appearance: Logan has short, uneven waves that refuse to lie flat, two dimples that appear only with a full smile, and a favorite piece of clothing, a narrow-striped sweater. It usually goes with a narrow brass watch set a little fast. When somebody else has the floor, Logan gives a little nod before asking a hard question.
personality: Logan keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Logan wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To offer a shared break to the people split by the new rota.
family: Lev Adair is Logan’s second cousin. Logan chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. Lev brings a spare shopping bag. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *The porch light*, Lev says, “The switch worked. He'd unscrewed the bulb to see who would notice.”
connections: Olivia Hu. They compare the price of buying back a tin with the cost of losing a shared break. Also in the story is Bianca Cole (break-room caretaker).

reactions.situation: An old tin is claimed by two crews
reactions.response: Logan invites both crews to describe the lid without putting either at fault.
reactions.asWritten: An old tin is claimed by two crews. Logan invites both crews to describe the lid without putting either at fault.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Logan writes down the shift time accurately, then helps them explain the circumstances without having to tell the whole room.

reactions.situation: When somebody asks who said it first
reactions.response: Logan offers to introduce them to the person willing to put a name to it.
